### The Message of Death
Author: Stuart Briscoe
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/one-year-devotions-for-men/the-message-of-death-one-year-devotions-for-men-may-20.html
Passage: Exodus 12:29-30
Points:
- Persistent resistance against God's demands ultimately brings unavoidable divine judgment, as demonstrated by Pharaoh.
- The midnight plague fell universally across Egypt, bringing devastation to every home from the royal palace to the dungeon.
- Confrontation with the reality of death shattered Pharaoh's arrogance, prompting him to release Israel and plead for a blessing.
- Human mortality delivers a sobering reminder of human limits and God's active intervention in history.
- While physical death is bitter, it finds hope and redemption through the death and resurrection of Jesus Christ.
